lang:attributes/the-names-the-compiler-a.perf: A name is recognized while the program compiles and reaches nothing at run time; a loop here would re-measure the codec, route or command row the recognized attribute built, each of which carries its own figure.

lang:classes/what-a-class-cannot-declare.perf: Every declaration here is a compile error, so there is no program to iterate; the replacements carry their own figures.

lang:concurrency/what-does-not-exist.perf: Every name here is a compile error, so there is no program to iterate; the replacements carry their own figures.

lang:errors/an-uncaught-throw.perf: A program ends once at an uncaught throw, so there is nothing to iterate; `lang:errors/throw` carries the throw's own figure.

lang:errors/fatal-errors-limits-no-catch.perf: A `FATAL` stops the program where it stands, so there is nothing to iterate; the allocation accounting that reaches the ceiling is measured by every allocating member's own figure.

tools:agents/nvs-agent-init.examples: `nvs agent init` reads no program and writes pointer files that state no language fact, so an example program would show nothing about the command; the fenced transcript in its section is what a reader learns from.
tools:agents/nvs-agent-init.hostile: `nvs agent init` reads no program, so no program can attack it; what can is an `AGENTS.md` or an adapter it did not write, and those files are pinned by `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs`.

tools:cli/nvs-info.examples: `nvs info` reads no program and prints the same report whatever program sits beside it, so an example program would show nothing about the command; the fenced output in its section is what a reader learns from.
tools:cli/nvs-info.hostile: `nvs info` reads no program and takes one flag, so no program can attack it; the argument spellings that must not reach it are pinned by `crates/nvs-cli/tests/info.rs`.
